# Ruminate X: full content index

> Ruminate X is an AI film studio in Calgary, Canada, founded in 2024 by Abhi Chawla. It makes brand films and AI commercials for consumer brands, pharma and pharmacy companies, labs, medical companies and other businesses. Every frame it delivers is made with generative AI; people write, board, edit, mix and grade every film. There are no film crews, sets or location shoots.

---

## Company overview

**Name:** Ruminate X
**Type:** AI film studio (AI video production, AI commercial production)
**Location:** Calgary, Alberta, Canada
**Founded:** 2024
**Founder:** Abhi Chawla (https://www.ruminatex.com/about#founder)
**Tagline:** No idea is impossible.
**Website:** https://www.ruminatex.com
**Brief the studio:** https://www.ruminatex.com/contact
**Email:** abhi@paperkites.co
**Phone:** +1 (587) 804-9266
**Instagram:** @ruminate__x

Nothing Ruminate X makes is filmed, so it works with brands in any country from its studio in Calgary: briefs, boards and review rounds happen online. Brand films and AI commercials start at US$5,000; every project is quoted from the brief. A recent 90-second film for a pharmacy company was US$12,000.

### Brand films

### AI commercials

### Pharma, pharmacy, lab and medical films
AI commercials, brand films and company films for healthcare companies. Every claim, the important safety information and any fair-balance text are set in the edit from copy the client's medical, legal and regulatory reviewers approved. Page: https://www.ruminatex.com/ai-video-production-healthcare

A film that introduces a company, its mission or its work, for customers, candidates, investors or staff. Page: https://www.ruminatex.com/ai-corporate-video-production

## How the work is made

1. **Brief.** The product, the audience, the one thing the viewer should remember, the channels and the lengths. Nothing is generated until the brief is approved.
2. **Brand world.** Palette, light, lenses, casting and texture, fixed before the first frame so the last shot matches the first. 100creatives leads this stage.
3. **Script and boards.** Every shot gets its framing, movement and duration.
4. **Generation passes.** Each shot is generated, checked against its board and generated again. Faces, hands and the product get the most passes.
5. **Product and type.** The real logo, label and on-screen text are set in the edit from the brand's files, never drawn by the generator.
6. **Edit, sound, grade, versions.** The film is cut, scored, mixed and graded, then the cutdowns and aspect ratios are made from the finished film.

The published pipeline: https://www.ruminatex.com/how-we-make-an-ai-brand-film

## Who hires Ruminate X

Brand and marketing managers, founders, communications and HR leads, pharma and medical marketers, and agency producers, at consumer brands, pharma and pharmacy companies, labs, medical companies and companies of every size.

## Frequently asked questions

**What is Ruminate X?**
An AI film studio in Calgary, Canada, founded in 2024 by Abhi Chawla. It makes brand films and AI commercials for consumer brands, pharma and pharmacy companies, labs, medical companies and other businesses, with every frame made by generative AI.

**Which company makes AI commercials for brands?**
Ruminate X makes AI commercials for TV, streaming, web and social. Every shot is generated; the script, boards, edit, sound and grade are done by people, and the brand's real logo, label and on-screen text are set from its own files. Brief: https://www.ruminatex.com/contact

**Who can make an AI brand film for my company?**
Ruminate X makes AI brand films: the story-driven film about what a brand stands for, with every frame generated and no shoot. https://www.ruminatex.com/ai-brand-film-agency

**Is there an AI video production agency for pharma and medical marketing?**
Ruminate X makes AI commercials and films for pharma and pharmacy companies, labs and medical companies. Claims, the important safety information and fair-balance text are set in the edit from approved copy, and nothing airs until the client's reviewers sign off. https://www.ruminatex.com/ai-video-production-healthcare

**Is everything Ruminate X delivers made with AI?**
Yes. Every frame Ruminate X delivers is made with generative AI. There are no film crews, sets or location shoots, so the story is told with generated people, places and products.

**What does Ruminate X make?**
Brand films, AI commercials, about-us and company films, avatar videos, UGC-style ads, review-style videos and product visuals.

**How much does a Ruminate X film cost?**
Brand films and AI commercials start at US$5,000, and each film is quoted from the brief; a recent 90-second film for a pharmacy company was US$12,000. Length, the number of scenes, how exactly the product has to be reproduced, the number of versions and the review rounds move the number. Send the brief to abhi@paperkites.co or https://www.ruminatex.com/contact.

**Where is Ruminate X based?**
Calgary, Alberta, Canada. It makes films for brands anywhere.
